title: Oracle Samsung Java Deal Ties Semiconductor Software To Long Term Cloud Story
title_zh: Oracle 三星 Java 交易将半导体软件与长期云故事联系起来
summary: Oracle and Samsung Electronics have expanded their partnership to standardize semiconductor software development on Oracle Java SE Universal Subscription.
summary_zh: Oracle 和三星电子扩大了合作伙伴关系，以标准化 Oracle Java SE 通用订阅上的半导体软件开发。

title: Week’s Best: ChatGPT to Offer Money Advice
title_zh: 本周最佳：ChatGPT 提供理财建议
summary: ChatGPT plans to turn its premium artificial intelligence offering into a financial counselor, of sorts.
summary_zh: ChatGPT 计划将其优质人工智能产品转变为某种财务顾问。

title: Apollo $2.04 Billion Takeover Proposal Propels Bodycote Share Gain
title_zh: Apollo 20.4 亿美元的收购提议推动 Bodycote 股价上涨
summary: Heat treatment firm Bodycote said it received a 1.52 billion pound ($2.04 billion) takeover proposal from Apollo Global Management, and that the two were in talks, sending shares sharply higher.
summary_zh: 热处理公司 Bodycote 表示，它收到了 Apollo Global Management 的 15.2 亿英镑（20.4 亿美元）收购提议，两家公司正在谈判，股价大幅上涨。

title: Tech ETFs to Buy as Microsoft, Anthropic Eye Custom AI Chip Deal
title_zh: 微软与 Anthropic Eye 定制人工智能芯片交易将买入科技 ETF
summary: Microsoft's Maia AI chip talks with Anthropic spotlight tech ETFs as a diversified way to tap the AI-driven custom silicon boom.
summary_zh: 微软的 Maia 人工智能芯片与 Anthropic 重点讨论科技 ETF，认为这是利用人工智能驱动的定制芯片热潮的多元化方式。

title: Warner Bros. Discovery increases leveraged loan backing Paramount Skydance deal atop $10B
title_zh: 华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 增加杠杆贷款支持派拉蒙 Skydance 交易至 $10B
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has upsized the dollar portion of its cross-border term loan to $9 billion from $5 billion, taking the total deal size to approximately $10 billion. The euros are unchanged at €1 billion. Responses remain due by 5 p.m. BST and 5 p.m.
summary_zh: 华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 将其跨境定期贷款的美元部分从 50 亿美元增加到 90 亿美元，使总交易规模达到约 100 亿美元。欧元维持在 10 亿欧元不变。回复截止日期为下午 5 点。英国夏令时和下午 5 点
